title: Craft/Mine/Find item
body:
# 🧠 CraftMine Challenge – Red vs Blue *(Legacy Datapack)*

**Multiplayer Minigame | Creative Puzzle | Vintage GUI Experience**

🎮 *This datapack was the original prototype for what is now a full-featured Fabric mod!*  
Looking for the best experience? Try the new mod version here:  
➡️ [Check out the Red vs Blue Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/craftmine-challenge)

---

## 🔥 Gameplay

- Two teams:
  - 🟥 **Red Team** – 1 player max. Must **craft or find** the item shown in chat.
  - 🟦 **Blue Team** – Any number of players. Must **mislead and confuse** the Red player into crafting **the wrong item**.
- If the Red player crafts the wrong item within the time limit — the **Blue Team wins**!
- If the correct item is crafted — **Red Team scores a point**.

---

## 🧰 Features

- 🧾 **Interactive menu** styled as a **double chest GUI**  
  (Minimal commands — visually driven interaction.)
- 🎨 **Custom textures & item icons** via built-in **resource pack**  
  (Vintage theme matching the "Old Memories" aesthetic.)
- ⏱️ Easy-to-configure **item timer** (set directly in-game).
- 📦 Lightweight and modular – ideal for small survival servers.

---

## 📜 Installation

1. Drop the `.zip` into your `datapacks/` folder.
2. Use `/reload` to activate.
3. Join the world and receive your **custom menu item**.
4. Click it to open the GUI and start playing!

---

## ⚠️ Note

This version is no longer actively developed.  
For new features, bug fixes, and full multiplayer support, download the Fabric mod version:  
➡️ [Red vs Blue Mod (Fabric 1.20.1)](https://modrinth.com/mod/craftmine-challenge)

---

> Originally created as a datapack experiment by **SeishiroNagi**  
> Now reborn as a polished Minecraft mod!
